decided_by: Product owner (packet P-LEG review: 'we don't pick the investment funds and pass all of fund management off to someone like Schwab')
decision: Neither Unbound nor the sponsor selects or manages investments and no sponsor-maintained investment pools are offered. Each sponsor delegates investment management of fund assets to an external registered investment manager or custodian platform (for example Schwab) under a written agreement. The sponsor board keeps the non-delegable duties to select the manager, set the scope and investment policy, and monitor performance and cost. Donors may recommend allocations only among options the manager makes available; Unbound relays those recommendations and ingests positions, transactions, units and valuations, and reconciles them.

Product strategy: one small, nimble core with two offers against the same incumbent: (1) DAF software licensed to sponsors and administrators, competing with Ren's iPhi platform; (2) an Unbound-operated administration team, competing with Ren's outsourced administration. Amends SPD-ADV-004 from 'software platform only' to 'software first, staffed administration as a planned second offer'. SPD-ADV-001 unchanged: Unbound staff may prepare and process; each sponsor's own appointed people make reserved decisions. Supersedes the OD-M-04 reopening trigger.

Ratify packet P-LEG: release 1 ships sponsor-branded portals only (no consumer marketplace, embedded checkout, Unbound-branded app or charity-side donation buttons), so California and Hawaii platform registration is required only before those features are enabled.

decided_by: Product owner (explicit ratification of packet P-PAY: 'Ratify with cuts A+B+C')
decision: Ratify packet P-PAY with three release-1 scope cuts: (A) no ACH debit origination from donors (donors push funds by ACH credit, wire, check or securities, or use the sponsor's existing processor); (B) one bank-feed adapter and one payment-partner adapter first (Chariot first, then PayPal), others by demand; (C) donor-covered fee rules deferred with card contributions.

decided_by: Product owner (explicit ratification of packet P-FIN: 'Ratify with cuts D+E')
decision: Ratify packet P-FIN with two release-1 scope cuts: (D) refuse assets that generate unrelated business taxable income (S-corporation stock, pass-through interests with UBTI, debt-financed property) and defer the UBIT accrual machinery; complex assets that intermediaries sell on receipt remain accepted; (E) support standard donor-advised funds only, deferring agency, organization-advised, pass-through and restricted account types.
